items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: I went to all of them when they came here, man. Caught me four and a half to see Louis Armstrong... I seen Night King Cole.

ctx.x: Do you remember Louis Armstrong when he started out?

Did you ever hear him talk about him? Well, I'll tell you. Well, I'll tell you about Louis Armstrong. He just, when he first come out, I heard about him, but I don't know when he started out, but I heard them fellas. Now you had to see, see, he come up with this fella on Bourbon Street. Now you call him Papa Celestine, learned them plenty. And then I heard about Joe Oliver who had learned them coming up. But the Petey, see you understand, the one took them out around them nightclubs and things. He the one gave me…
You remember the district when it was running up here?

items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-30
items.q: I heard it when Louis Armstrong came on the record.

ctx.x: When did you first hear when the Saints go marching in? Did they ever sing that years ago?

No, no. Well I heard it when Louis Armstrong came on the record. Yeah. That's when Louis Armstrong come on the record. They go marching in. You never heard the band play at them before? No, not before Louis Armstrong. Sure didn't. And you didn't hear it in the church? No. Well they used to sing. Used to sing, but I know music. They used to sing. I know music.
Well that looks like about the end of the tape.
